name: Einwerfen
summary: German 4-player partnership point-trick game with a 32-card pack, related to Sueca, where teams score for card-points.
rules_text: Four players form two fixed teams sitting opposite. A 32-card German pack is used, tens rank low and cards have ace-ten values. After drawing for partners and dealer, trump is cut and 8 cards are dealt to each player in 4s. Trick play follows Whist: any card may be led, players must follow suit if able, otherwise may play any card. Highest trump wins the trick, otherwise highest of led suit; winner leads next. After 8 tricks card-points are totaled. 61-90 points wins 1 chip (Lump), 91-119 wins 2 (Matsch), 120 wins 3 (Bombe). A tie is carried to next deal. The trump of the first deal is favourite and doubles scores when it recurs.
